youtube.title: Where were the first modern Olympics held? A few hundred men and not one woman 🥇
youtube.description:
Paris, London or the third one? The first modern Games opened in a stadium rebuilt in marble for the occasion, with a few hundred athletes from 14 nations and no women at all. The marathon was run for the very first time, and a water carrier won it.
Guess before the map lights up, then follow the marathon route into the stadium and meet the first champion.
Which did you pick?
